I feel like I'm just going through the motions today, you know? Like I'm not even really here. I was talking to my sister yesterday and she asked me how my day was and I told her it was fine and that's what I usually say anyway. But sometimes I wonder if anyone would even notice if I wasn't around. Would they just keep on doing the same stuff, living their lives without even thinking about me? It's a weird thought to have.

And then there's this thing where I feel like I'm completely disconnected from everyone in my life. Like, we're all just floating around each other but not really actually touching or knowing what's going on with anyone else. My friends are always posting updates and pictures of their lives on social media and it feels like they're trying to prove that they're still relevant or something. I don't get it. Can't we just be okay with being boring for once?

I was thinking about this stuff the other day and I realized that I've been feeling really isolated lately. Like, even when I'm with people, I feel like I'm on the outside looking in. And that's a weird feeling because usually I'm the one who's always trying to make connections and be social. But now it just feels like I'm not really doing anything right.

It's hard to explain but sometimes I get this feeling of being completely invisible. Like, if you were standing next to me on the street and didn't look over, you'd never even notice I was there. That sounds terrible but that's how I feel most of the time lately.
